text.p: Zannex Securities rated Super-Sol Ltd a buy, saying several factors will strengthen the stock price of the Israeli supermarket chain in the next 12 months.
"The 1997 planned Nasdaq IPO will attract international attention," Zannex said in a report on Monday.

The divestiture of its loss making Super Office subsidiary will save an average of 15 million shekels a year and profitability is expected to improve at its newly acquired Shekem stores. Shekem's monthly sales are expected to grow from $600 per square meter to $850 by the first half of 1998.
Zannex estimates Super-Sol will earn 0.61 shekels a share in 1997 and 0.76 in 1998 against 0.58 in 1996. The shares are trading at a 1998 price/earnings ratio of 15.9.
